sources.title: Deposit and withdrawal network status recheck during XRP phase-one window
claims: At retrieval the page displayed last-updated text 2026-10-30 01:00 with timezone undisclosed and a No Data table.
The page did not expose an XRP-specific available/paused row during the announced 2026-11-01 06:00-09:00 UTC phase-one window.
limitations: The status page is stale relative to the announced window.
No XRP availability conclusion can be drawn from an empty status table.
No successful customer withdrawal transaction was independently observed.

sources.title: XRP supply report and spot ETF flows, week ending October 30, 2026
claims: Reported 1.1966B XRP held across six spot funds plus BITW and approximately $1.503B AUM.
Reported weekly net holdings change of approximately +3.39M XRP for October 26-30.
Reported October 29 +6.40M XRP and October 30 -49,932 XRP.
Flow totals exclude GXRP while its holdings remain included; BITW is included in the tracker universe.
limitations: Flow is derived from holdings changes, not a direct cash-subscription ledger.
GXRP flow data is excluded because of a source gap.
Historical rows include some reconstructed observations; the tracker documents these in its methodology.
Provider totals cannot be compared without matching fund universe and cutoff.

sources.title: XRP ETF daily and weekly net-flow tracker
claims: Reported approximately -$496.5K on October 30, +$4.3M over the past week and +$19M over the past month.
Tracker reports five funds: XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR.
limitations: Five-fund universe differs from XRP Insights, which includes BITW and other spot funds while excluding GXRP from flow totals.
Cash-flow methodology is not fully reconciled to issuer-level XRP inventory changes.
Do not average with holdings-delta data.

sources.title: US XRP spot ETF net inflows on October 29, 2026
claims: Reported approximately $8.4316M total net inflow on October 29.
Reported XRPZ and Bitwise as the largest contributors in the published breakdown.
limitations: Republished provider data, not a primary issuer cash ledger.
Fund universe and calculation basis must be matched before comparison with holdings-delta trackers.

sources.title: XRP perpetual futures open interest and venue snapshot
claims: Reported approximately $1.9B XRP open interest across 13 venues at 04:43 UTC.
Reported XRP price near $1.2508, 24-hour turnover near $608.1M and weighted funding near +0.0100% per eight hours.
Reported venue-specific funding dispersion, including negative Bybit funding and positive Binance funding.
limitations: Venue and contract inclusion rules are not fully aligned with other aggregators.
Snapshot is not a consolidated exchange audit feed.
Do not combine with narrower contract-only or broader CME-inclusive totals.

sources.title: XRP derivatives open-interest snapshot
claims: Reported approximately $749.19M open interest across seven contracts at 05:34 UTC.
Reported weighted funding near +0.0047% per eight hours and 24-hour volume near $399.61M.
limitations: Seven-contract universe is narrower than venue-wide aggregators.
Not comparable to 13-venue or 26-exchange totals.
The provider's contract inclusion and notional conversion require further audit.

sources.title: XRP open interest by exchange
claims: Reported approximately $1.6B open interest across nine exchanges at 05:58 UTC.
Published exchange-level values broadly consistent with a narrower venue set than CME-inclusive aggregators.
limitations: Exchange universe differs from other providers.
Not a primary exchange contract ledger.
Do not average with Kodexius, Kairo, TRdesk or CoinGlass.

sources.title: XRP derivatives open interest across 26 exchanges
claims: Reported approximately $2.66B XRP open interest across 26 exchanges.
Includes CME in its venue set; CME was shown as a material component.
limitations: Broader venue and contract universe than perpetual-only dashboards.
CME futures and perpetual swaps should be separated before model use.
Page observation time was not exposed in the retrieved result.

sources.title: XRP futures and spot market dashboard
claims: Dashboard displayed approximately $2.81B open interest, $893.75M futures volume and $166.07M spot volume in the retrieved observation.
limitations: The page did not expose a synchronized observation timestamp in the captured result.
Coverage and contract methodology differ from narrower providers.
Do not use as a point-in-time feature without timestamped raw capture.

sources.title: XRP Ledger stablecoin market-cap snapshot
claims: Displayed approximately $799.09M total stablecoin market cap on XRPL.
Displayed RLUSD dominance near 88.55% and approximately -24.55% seven-day change.
limitations: Token inclusion and pricing methodology are provider-defined.
Stablecoin supply is a stock measure, not transfer volume or XRP demand.
Seven-day change does not identify redemption versus cross-chain migration or reclassification.

sources.title: XRP Ledger stablecoin supply by asset
claims: Displayed approximately $712.2M total XRPL stablecoin supply at 06:10 UTC.
Displayed approximately $707.4M RLUSD and $4.8M USDC on XRPL.
limitations: Total stablecoin universe differs from DefiLlama; the totals are not interchangeable.
On-chain supply does not measure velocity, CEX settlement or net capital flows.
RLUSD chain-supply change requires transfer, issuance and redemption tracing.

sources.title: USDC transparency and reserve statistics
claims: Displayed approximately $70.0B USDC in circulation and $71.4B reserve funds as of October 29.
Displayed seven-day net supply change near -$0.8B, 30-day near -$3.1B and 365-day near -$5.0B.
limitations: Issuer-level global figures are not XRPL-specific.
Other aggregators display different total circulating-supply figures and may use different cutoffs or chain coverage.
Gross issuance/redemption volume is not the same as net supply change.

sources.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 results and strategic diversification
claims: Reported Coinbase Q3 revenue down approximately 37% and transaction revenue down approximately 43% to $590.2M.
Reported net income of $718.7M was heavily supported by unrealized crypto investment gains; adjusted net income was materially lower.
Reported market-share and prediction-market/derivatives diversification indicators, including prediction-market revenue annualized above $200M.
limitations: Secondary reporting; SEC filings remain primary for financial line items.
Market-share and annualized revenue figures depend on the cited measurement period and methodology.
Do not infer XRP-specific trading or collateral demand from company-wide results.

sources.title: Capital and business alliance with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group
claims: SBI Holdings and SMFG announced a capital and business alliance to explore stablecoin and digital-finance services.
The announcement positions the alliance around broader digital-asset and payment infrastructure.
limitations: The announcement does not establish a Ripple or XRP product integration.
Exploration and alliance terms are not proof of production flows or committed capital deployment into XRP.

sources.title: SBI, Startale and BlackRock memorandum on tokenized money-market fund and JPYSC
claims: SBI, Startale and BlackRock announced exploratory work linking a tokenized money-market-fund concept with JPYSC.
The announcement is an MOU/exploration, not a completed public settlement product.
limitations: No Ripple or XRP integration is identified in the announcement.
No production transaction volume, tokenized-fund AUM or XRP collateral use is disclosed.

sources.title: SBI Group and Startale join Open Standard
claims: SBI Group and Startale joined Open Standard, a consortium described as having more than 140 participants including Coinbase, BlackRock, Visa, Stripe and Mastercard.
The announcement describes planned interoperability testing between JPYSC and OUSD.
limitations: OUSD is distinct from Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD.
A planned interoperability test does not establish production usage or XRP routing.
No direct XRP integration is named.

sources.title: JPYSC issuance and initial SBI VC Trade account distribution
claims: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank announced JPYSC issuance with initial distribution through SBI VC Trade accounts.
Public-chain circulation was described as a later step after legal, tax and operational issues are addressed.
limitations: Initial account distribution is not evidence of public-chain circulation.
No XRP or XRPL bridge requirement is identified.

sources.title: SBI START bond investor XRP reward campaign
claims: The SBI START bond offering on ibet for Fin included XRP rewards to eligible purchasers according to purchase amount.
limitations: The bond is not denominated in XRP and is not issued on XRPL.
The announcement does not establish reward totals, market-purchase amounts or secondary-market demand.

sources.title: SBI shareholder benefit XRP coupon program
claims: SBI described a shareholder-benefit program distributing XRP acquisition coupon codes through SBI VC Trade.
limitations: Coupon distribution is not a disclosed open-market purchase quantity.
Redemption rates and actual XRP acquired by recipients are not disclosed.

sources.title: PR #1446 scheduled issue and metrics writer quarantine
claims: PR #1446 changes five scheduled workflows to read-only/artifact-first operation and defaults issue-mutating scripts to dry-run.
Exact head a5f98fa2fc53a8875e45017f5ec4bdcedcead080 passed 346 tests and eight subtests in CI run 41281605535.
Fail-closed gate run 41281605590 passed with merging disabled.
limitations: PR remains draft, open and unmerged; main still has the old workflow capabilities.
CI success verifies the proposed branch, not production deployment or main-branch remediation.

notes: All new source records were captured from public pages or repository-visible evidence.
Primary filings and company announcements are separated from secondary market aggregators.
Provider observations are not averaged where universes, timestamps or methodologies differ.
No market feature is admitted and no forecast is issued.
